entries.title: Random Mystery Cave
highlights: New Crafting Cube recipe: 1 Wooma Heart + 1 Black Iron Ore (any purity) makes a Random Mystery Cave Ticket.
Random Cave is infinite and gets stronger each spawn. Bodies and stats can mismatch, and some hits steal another boss's attack effect.
Bodies and stat donors are drawn from the whole walking roster (Chicken through Oma King), and borrowed attack effects now come from any of 22 monsters that have one, not just four bosses.

Difficulty is a widening range instead of a ramp. Waves 1–5 can never roll worse than Wooma Taurus, the ceiling then climbs one small step at a time until anything up to Oma King is possible around wave 45, and the pick inside that range is flat — so a lucky run can stay easy well past wave 50, and an unlucky one can meet something nasty at wave 10. Stats no longer scale with the ceiling; they only start escalating once the range has fully opened, which is what eventually ends a run.
Empowered / Ascended / Awakened apply 2× / 3× / 4× HP and damage (and gold/EXP) for free, same as Mystery Cave.
The chest pays one prize per 5 kills, from a sun potion up to a 4★ item — including Wooden Sword. Equipment rolls only use items that already drop from zones or bosses.

Gold and EXP are a single roll for the whole run. Each kill raises the ceiling — 25,000 gold per kill, so 10 kills means "up to 250,000" — and the run pays out anything from 1 up to that ceiling. EXP works the same way, so a long run can still pay almost nothing. Deep runs are a bigger gamble, not a bigger salary.

Fixed Random Cave EXP going backwards: at certain kill counts one extra kill lowered the EXP ceiling instead of raising it — 24 kills paid 46% less than 23, with smaller drops at 10, 11 and 15. Killing more now never pays less.

A ticket run is once per day. Entering starts a 24 hour cooldown shared across all your characters, so extra tickets stockpile for tomorrow instead of stacking runs today. Using a ticket during the cooldown still opens the entry page and shows the time remaining, and the ticket is not spent.
Random Mystery Cave is reached with the ticket only. It is no longer listed in Teleport (Past Bicheon) or the Teleport Ring.

entries.title: Fifth glyph slot
highlights: Add Additional Glyph Slot can be bought a fourth time for 1000 rebirth points, unlocking a 5th glyph equip slot.

entries.title: Glyph of Blight
highlights: New Taoist glyph: Plague also attempts Curse on the same targets, using Curse's duration, power, and hit chances. Requires Curse learned.

entries.title: Glyph of Last Stand
highlights: New Taoist glyph: Energy Shield no longer heals. It saves each player from one fatal blow, then breaks. That player cannot receive Energy Shield again for 5 minutes.

entries.title: Glyph of Shared Skin
highlights: New Warrior glyph: Immortal Skin also buffs your party with your AC and MAC. Your DC penalty is doubled.

entries.title: Immortal Skin from Oma King
highlights: Oma King now drops the Immortal Skin book at 10%.

entries.title: Energy Shield buff text
highlights: The Energy Shield HUD buff now shows proc chance and HP instead of the internal ENERGYSHIELD tag.

entries.title: Magic Shield first
highlights: Wizard autocast now keeps Magic Shield above Magic Booster and Mirroring in combat and boss parties, so the shield goes up before other support spells.

entries.title: Glyph of Provision
highlights: New glyph: matching potions in your bag are used before the hotbar stack. You no longer gain gold while it is equipped.

entries.title: Glyph of Execution
highlights: New Warrior glyph: Slaying always readies after you strike, takes priority over other weapon skills, and cannot miss. The blow deals 2.5× damage while the target is above 50% HP, or 9× at or below 50% HP.

entries.title: Glyph of Blood Shield
highlights: New Wizard glyph: Vampirism can heal you up to 150% of your maximum HP. The extra 50% is a health buffer that damage eats first.

entries.title: Glyph of Focused Meteor
highlights: New Wizard glyph: Meteor Strike hits a single target and deals double damage.

entries.title: Two more bosses in Mystery Cave
highlights: Crystal Spider and Red Evil Ape now join the Mystery Cave gauntlet — they were missing even though every other roaming boss was in. A full clear is 25 bosses over 20 waves.
Crystal Spider arrives 2nd and Red Evil Ape 6th, so both sit early in the run and each drops from its own loot table.

entries.title: Pass items in group dungeons
highlights: While out of combat in a group dungeon or KR, drag an item from your bag onto another character's paper doll or nameplate to put it in their inventory.
If that character's bag is full, you get a notice and keep the item.

entries.title: Boss Junk Filter
highlights: Added Boss Junk Filter — a toggle on Auto-Junk Filters. When on, bosses stop dropping plain copies of those items so you clear your bag far less often. Empowered and Awakened drops always still land.
Buy it in the Rebirth shop for 100 rebirth points or in the Cash Shop for 300 tokens.

entries.title: Awakened Dragon Slayer
highlights: Added Awakened Dragon Slayer, a Minotaur King Awakened exclusive. While equipped, every hit crits and Warrior skills spend HP instead of MP.

entries.title: Awakened Soul Sabre
highlights: Added Awakened Soul Sabre, a Bone Lord Awakened exclusive. Soul Fire Ball deals +100% damage and casts at the fastest speed the animation can hold.

entries.title: Awakened Dragon Staff
highlights: Added Awakened Dragon Staff, a Bone Lord Awakened exclusive. Great Fire Ball deals +100% damage and casts at the fastest speed the animation can hold.

entries.title: Past Bicheon & Mystery Cave
highlights: Added Past Bicheon group dungeon with Frost Tiger and Oma King. Designed to be incredibly difficult and end game. Evil Mir to come soon.
Added new items and spell books for Frost Tiger and Oma King drops.
Added Mystery Cave. Craft a Mystery Cave Ticket to run a boss swarm. Wipe or clear for a chest with a choice of rewards.
Vampirism casts first when the Wizard is below 80% HP.

entries.title: Armoury, glyphs & balance
highlights: Added Armoury kits at Blacksmith Bill — save and swap gear kits in town (2 free per character; 3rd kit in the Cash Shop for 300 tokens).
Added 9 new glyphs.
Added a fourth glyph equip slot (Rebirth upgrade, 750 RP).
Glyph of Mana Aegis now keeps Magic Shield at half damage reduction instead of removing it.
Flaming Sword cooldown can no longer drop below 3 seconds.
Holy Deva thunder now scales from your SC (×2) instead of a fixed pet DC.
Additive damage reduction is now capped at 75%.
Automatic cloud backups now wait 2 minutes after opening the game or tabbing back in, so you can restore from another device first without overwriting the newer save.

entries.title: Glyph fix, Awakened drops & mining upgrades
highlights: Fixed glyph crafting bug.
Fixed drops for a couple of Awakened weapons.
Added rebirth upgrades for better ore mining rates.

entries.title: Unique weapons, Attunement Stones & Idle
highlights: Added 3 new unique weapons.
Added Attunement Stones to the crafting recipes. These increase your chance of targeting their respective empowerment types when rerolling.
Fixed a few bugs.
Added a manual button to start Idle mode for more control.
Added ore stacking (doesn't work for Black Iron Ore) as both a rebirth point upgrade and a cash shop upgrade.
Nerfed Dark Devil AOE damage.

entries.title: Awakened bosses, Namman & Glyphs
highlights: Added a third glyph equip slot (Rebirth upgrade).
Added Namman Demon Fields and Danmo to Southern Barbarian Lands.
Added Glyph Recycling to the crafting cube — turn 2 glyphs you don't want into a random new one.
Added more stats to the Stats 2 page.
Added Awakened bosses — the next (and final) tier up for bosses.
Added 3 new Awakened items. These can be seen in the Codex and only drop from specific Awakened bosses.
Unique items (including Awakened weapons) can no longer be sealed in the Spirit Box, same as Ethereal gear.
Changed Glyph of Disruptor Cascade to be more useful.

entries.title: New zones, glyphs & dungeon auto-advance
highlights: Added Southern Barbarian Land and Hell Lord.
Added 8 new glyphs.
Added Auto-junk filters — drag bag items onto the pad to auto-mark future plain copies as junk.
Your player ID is now tied to your recovery code to help reduce duplicate accounts.
Ascended bosses now have a higher chance to drop glyphs.
Empowered and Ascended bosses now get extra rolls for Awakening Souls.
Cash Shop: Group Dungeon Auto Advance (200 tokens) — tick Auto advance next to the Advance button in multi-stage group dungeons (Black Dragon Dungeon, Hell Cavern, and future ones).
Using a skill book you already know adds +200 skill XP to that spell (consumes the book). No effect if the skill is mastered or you are under the next skill-level character requirement.

entries.title: Shared gold, UI & Options
highlights: Gold is now account-wide, not character-specific.
Added character-specific HP and MP auto potion sliders in the Options menu.
Added back the UI update with some changes.
Fixed character selection UI size issue.
Removed HP and MP flashing.
You can now toggle the Mir GUI or the Idle text-based GUI in the top right of the game window.
Mir GUI is automatically removed on mobile devices.

entries.title: Ice Hell, Glyphs & Ascended
highlights: Added Ice Hell wing to Hell Cavern.
Added more Glyphs.
BDD and all the other bosses can now be empowered.
Added Ascended mode. Like Empowered, but bosses drop even more.
Added new level 50 Heaven Armour.
Change Tao pet so it now teleports when out of combat.
Added Poison Cloud to drops.

entries.title: Fox Cave, late game & Glyphs
highlights: Added Fox Cave 1, 2 and KR.
Added Greater Fox Spirit and Fox items.
Rebalanced current late game items and armours.
Added new late game armour and weapons.
Added drops to Hell Guardian.
Added Plague to Dark and Dream Devourer drops.
Added Glyphs — 10% chance to drop from Empowered bosses. Only 7 in game at the moment while they get tested.
Fixed duplication bug (Thanks SmavidDavid).

entries.title: Codex, achievements & UI
highlights: Added Empowerments to the Codex.
Added new achievements.
Slightly moved the Sort button.
Added Testing Room to the trainer so you can measure your DPS.

entries.title: Boss souls & Spirit Box
highlights: New crafting recipe: IWT Soul — teleport directly to Incarnated Wooma Taurus.
New crafting recipe: IZT Soul — teleport directly to Incarnated Zuma Taurus.
New crafting recipe: DD Soul — teleport directly to Dark Devil.
New rebirth item: Spirit Box — save one non-Ethereal item between rebirths for 100 souls or 200 tokens.

entries.title: What's New
highlights: Patch notes are now in-game. Open Options → What's New anytime, or tap What's new on the update bar before you reload.
